The '''Southern Sleetlands''' was a region on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and their [[Alien/Legends|alien]] allies maintained a [[forward alien camp]] and the [[Republic base camp]] on the Sleetlands.<ref name="TOR" />
